attr.title: SegaRallyArm (Sega Rally Championship 1995)
attr.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 handheld port of segarally95-recomp (Sega Model 2A CRX static recompilation for Sega Rally Championship 1995), engineered for Anbernic RG34XX (Allwinner H700 / Mali-G31 MP2) and compatible PortMaster AArch64 Linux handhelds. 57.52 FPS locked arcade speed with 4-core pipelining, real-time SCSP/68EC000 audio synthesis, and D-pad arcade spring centering steering.
attr.inst:
1. Copy your legally owned MAME ROM archive (srallyc.zip / srallycb.zip) or extracted ROM blocks (srallyc-b/) into ports/segarallyarm/roms/.
2. Launch Sega Rally.sh (or Sega Rally Practice.sh for instant Desert stage practice).
3. Default Controls: D-Pad / Left Stick = Steering, A = Throttle, B = Brake, X = Change View, L1/R1 = Sequential Gear Shifter, Select = Coin, Start = Start. Press Select+Start simultaneously to exit.
